Items.name: Ancient Fairy Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Light Wyvern + Light-Ray.
Seal; Choose 1 effect.
1: Summon 1 creature that costs 4 Mana or less from your hand.
2: Destroy 1 Field Spell and gain 10 Life.

Items.name: Black Fiendish Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Fiendish Skull + Black Dragon.
When this card attacks and destroys a creature by battle, deal Life damage to the enemy equal to that creature's DEF.

Items.name: Brainsite
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Parasite + Paracide.
Seal; Take control of 1 Insect creature the enemy controls.

Items.name: Chilled Magician
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Magician Apprentice + Magician Apprentice.

Items.name: Comic Clownbox
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Dark Clown + Comic Page Flip.
You can only control 1 Comic creature at a time.
When this card is Unsealed, destroy 1 creature.
Death; Add 1 Comic card from your Graveyard to your hand.

Items.name: Comic Ultimate Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Ultimate White Dragon + Comic Page Flip.
You can only control 1 Comic creature at a time.
This card can't be destroyed by Spell cards.
Death; Add 1 card from your Graveyard to your hand.

Items.name: Dark Dragoon Magician
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Black Dragon + Magician of Chaos + The Dark Magician.
This card can't be destroyed by Spell effects.
Quick; Negate an effect until the end of this turn.

Items.name: Darksider Chaos Angel
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Darksider Ruler + Darksider Dragon Overlord + Darksider Madking.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
This card can't be destroyed by Spell effects.
Battlecry; Destroy all other cards on the field.
Seal; Add 2 cards with Darksider in their names from your Banish Zone to your hand.

Items.name: Darksider Dragon Overlord
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Darksider Ruler + Black Dragon + Darksider Goldmen + Darksider Halberd.
Battlecry; Each player discards 1 card.
Quick; Until the end of this turn, change the effect of 1 card to "The enemy discards 1 card."
Death; Summon 1 different creature with Darksider in its name from your Graveyard.

Items.name: Dragon Lord Supreme
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Dragon Lord Flames + Dragon Lord Stones + Dragon Lord Storms.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
Battlecry; Add 2 Dragons from your Banish Zone to your Deck.
Seal; Banish 2 creatures with Dragon Lord in their names from your Graveyard to destroy 2 cards.
Death; You can Banish 2 Fire creatures from your Graveyard to return this card to your Fusion Deck instead.

Items.name: Dragon Zombie Lord
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Zombie Dragon + Zombie Master + Zombie Mammoth.
Battlecry; Summon 1 creature from the enemy's Graveyard to your field. It becomes a Zombie.

Items.name: Elemental Compound Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Black Dragon + Flaming Dragon + Moon Dragon + Dragon Lord Waves + Thunder Strike Dragon.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
This card can't be destroyed by Spell cards.
This card can't be destroyed by battle, except by Light creatures.

Items.name: Flaming Swordsman
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Elf Warrior + Flaming Dragon.
When this card attacks, it gets +3 ATK until the end of this turn.

Items.name: Goddess Magician
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Sweet Magician Girl + Magician of Faith.
You can use Spells with Magician in their names while a creature with Magician in its name is defending against an attack.

Items.name: Herald of Light
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Forest Witch + Petit Fairy.
Quick; Negate a Spell effect until the end of this turn.
Death; Add 1 Spell from your Graveyard to your hand.

Items.name: Knight Dragon Rider
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Elf Warrior + Moon Dragon.
Death; Add 1 Warrior from your Graveyard to your hand.

Items.name: Light Shining Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Herald of Light + White Dragon.
Battlecry; This card gets +1/+1 for each Light creature in your Graveyard.
Death; Destroy all cards on the field.

Items.name: Lord of Toxic Snakes
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Toxic Serpent + 3 Reptile creatures.
Effects that give Toxic Tokens give twice as many.
If this card is destroyed by battle, you can Banish 1 creature with Toxic in its name from your Graveyard to summon this card.

Items.name: Muk Muk
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Dark Eyes Fiend + Dark Eyes Fiend + Dark Eyes Fiend.

Items.name: Over-Tech Blaster Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Triple Barrel Dragon + Blaster Spider + X Double Cannon.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
Seal; Roll.
1= Draw 1 card.
2-4= Deal 5 damage to 1 creature on the field.
5= Deal 3 damage to all enemy creatures.
6= Destroy up to 2 cards on the field.

Items.name: Phantom Night Fiend
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Dark Eyes Fiend + Hairy Fiend + Forest Witch.
Battlecry; Draw 5 cards, then shuffle 3 cards from your hand into your Deck.

Items.name: Queen of Toxic Snakes
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Lord of Toxic Snakes + 3 Reptile creatures.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
Once per turn, Seal 1 enemy creature with Toxic Tokens. Its ATK becomes 0 until the end of this turn.
When this card destroys an enemy creature with 0 ATK, summon that creature to your field.
If this card is destroyed by an effect, you can Banish 2 creatures with Toxic in their names from your Graveyard to summon this card.

Items.name: Rav Archangel of the End
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; The Hooded One + Phantom Night Fiend + Herald of Light.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
This card is unaffected by other cards' effects.

Items.name: Relaxing Cow
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Dairy Cow + Dairy Cow.

Items.name: Shipsunk Sea-Ken
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Ship Sail Sailors + White Kraken.

Items.name: Skelly Skeleton
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Skeleton + Skeleton.

Items.name: Stormnado Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Drake Breezer + Gust Dragon.
Quick; Destroy 1 Spell on the field.

Items.name: Supreme King Guardian
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Maze Guardian + 3 different Twin Guardian creatures.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
This card can't be destroyed by Spell cards.
Seal; Destroy 1 card, then draw 1 card.
Death; Summon 1 creature with Twin Guardian in its name from your Graveyard, ignoring its summoning cost.

Items.name: The Hive Queen
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Great Moth + Killer Sting + Larvae Cocoon.
Your Insect creatures can't be destroyed by Spells.
If this card would be destroyed, you can destroy 1 other Insect you control instead.
At the end of your turn, summon a 1/1 Insect Token.

Items.name: The Hooded One
Items.rulesText: Fusion; Fugue The Ancient Keeper + Nib the Primal Lord.

Items.name: The Legendary Necross
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Can only be summoned by using the effect of Head of the Sealed One.
This card is unaffected by other cards' effects.
When this card battles, its ATK is equal to your Life.
At the end of your turn, lose 4 Life.
Once during your turn, you can destroy 1 creature or Spell on the field.
Quick; Negate an effect until the end of this turn.

Items.name: The Primal Warrior
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Nib the Primal Lord + Flaming Swordsman.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
Battlecry; Destroy all other creatures on the field.
Neither player can summon creatures.

Items.name: The Unstoppable Mech Fortress
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Mecha Soldier + Mech Defender + Mech Defender + Mech Defender.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
Other Machines you control can't be attacked.
Seal; Add 1 Machine from your Deck to your hand.
Death; Add 3 Machines from your Graveyard to your hand.

Items.name: Tide Champion
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Tide Knight + Tide Supporter + Tide Bouncer.
If another Aqua creature is destroyed by battle, add it to your hand instead.

Items.name: Tide Radiant
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Tide Hocus + Tide Pocus + Tide Focus.
Battlecry; Return all other Unsealed creatures to their owners' hands.

Items.name: Twin-Mouth Thunder Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Thunder Strike Dragon + Thunder Strike Dragon.
At the end of your turn, Unseal this card.

Items.name: Ultimate Black Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Black Dragon + Black Dragon + Black Dragon.
After this card attacks, deal 5 damage to all enemy creatures.

Items.name: Ultimate Chimera
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Bat + Warr-Hog + Black Dragon + Hungry Lizard.
Battlecry; Destroy up to 3 creatures on the field with less DEF than this card.
Death; Draw 1 card.

Items.name: Ultimate Eye Restrict
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Dark Eyes Fiend + Dark Eyes Fiend + Eye Restrict.
Petrify all other creatures on the field.

Items.name: Ultimate White Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; White Dragon + White Dragon + White Dragon.
After this card attacks, deal 6 damage to all enemy creatures.

Items.name: Waking Fiend Dragon
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Moon Dragon + Horned Fiend.
When a Seal effect is activated, negate it.

Items.name: Zombie king Kaiser
Items.rulesText:
Fusion; Pumpkin King + Ha King Kaiser + 2 Zombie creatures.
Cannot be summoned without listed cards.
While this card is on the field, all creatures on the field and in Graveyards are Zombies.
Seal; Summon 1 Zombie from either player's Graveyard to your field.
